summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for the Galafold (migalastat) NDA 208623. The Multi-Disciplinary Review (Section 9) states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues warranting AC discussion. Galafold received accelerated approval; because no AdComm was held, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
